concepts.def: Self-contained section of coast with sources, transport pathways and sinks; England has 11; e.g. cell 1 Berwick-Flamborough.
State where inputs and outputs of energy/sediment are balanced; coast adjusts when conditions change.
Eustatic = global sea level change (melting ice); isostatic = local land movement (post-glacial rebound in Scotland).
Yorkshire boulder clay coast; 1.8m/year erosion; fastest in Europe; Mappleton lost 4m/year before defences.
DEFRA strategies: hold the line, advance, managed realignment, no active intervention; balance cost and benefit.
1190 islands averaging 1.5m elevation; could be uninhabitable by 2050 with sea level rise; demonstrates LIC vulnerability.
